encoding: SDR sRGB encoded bytes in Rgba8Unorm
stage: final engine output before identity present
cpu_profile_scope: 1 ms sampler requested after engine ready marker before prime; observed within 10 ms; ends on child exit; separate profiled arms

system_load.disk_scope: default devices including spool disk0; first row since boot; subsequent rows 1 s averages
system_load.process_cpu_scope: ps lifetime CPU snapshot, not interval CPU; load averages are host-wide
system_load.sampler: iostat -d -C -U -w 1 subprocess plus one ps snapshot, same recipe in each arm
